chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, all from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Wallad, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the Takbeer upon the deceased, so he said: 'Five. You should say in the first of them: I testify that there is no god but Allah, Alone, without partner. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.'

Then you should say: O Allah, this one enshrouded before us is Your servant and the son of Your servant, and You have taken his soul to Yourself, and he is in need of Your Mercy, and You are Self-Sufficient regarding his punishment. O Allah, we do not know from his exterior except goodness, and You are more Knowing of his inner self. O Allah, if he was a good-doer, increase in his goodness, and if he was a bad-doer, overlook his sins.
Then you say Takbeer for the second time, and do that in every Takbeer.

key_terms.الْمُسَجَّى: The enshrouded one (wrapped in burial shroud)

ai.seo_question: What are the specific supplications and Takbeer sequence for the prayer over the deceased in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi details the ritual structure of Salat al-Mayyit, specifically highlighting the theological balance between hope and fear through the supplication 'If he was a doer of good, increase his good; if he was a doer of evil, overlook his evil.' It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on intercessory prayer (Du'a) and the divine attribute of mercy, where the living advocate for the deceased while acknowledging God's ultimate knowledge of the unseen (Sirr).

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and a number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Wallad who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the exclamations of Takbeer upon the deceased, so heasws said: ‘Five. You should be saying in the first of these, ‘I testify that there is no God except for Allahazwj, Alone, there being no associates for him. O Allahazwj! Send Blessings upon Muhammadsaww and the Progenyasws of Muhammad’. Then you should be saying, ‘O Allahazwj! This enshrouded one in front of us is Yourazwj servant, and a son of Yourazwj servant, and his sould has been Captured to (come) to Youazwj, and he is needy to Yourazwj Mercy and Youazwj Needless from Punishing him. O Allahazwj! We deo not know from his apparent except for goodness and Youazwj are more Knowing of his secrets. O Allahazwj! If he was a good doer, so Increase in his good eeds; and if he was an evil doer, so Overlook from his sins’. Then exclaim the second Takbeer and you should do that during each Takbeer’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from a number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad all from ibn Mahbub from abu Wallad who has said the following: “

I once asked abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about Takbir over a deceased person. He (the Imam) said, ‘There are five Takbir. In the first one say, “I testify that only Allah deserves worship, He is one and has no partners and I testify that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. O Allah, I pray to You to grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause.”

Then say, “O Lord, this person, shrouded in front of us, is your servant and the son of Your servant whose soul You have taken to Yourself, and he is in need for your mercy and You do not need his being punished. O Lord, if he is a person of good deeds, increase his good deeds; if he is a person of bad deeds, forgive his sins.”
Then say the second Takbir and do the same after every Takbir.”
